title: Unsanitary Food
description: Eating raw food is no longer safe.
body:
# Core Mechanics

This mod introduces risk mechanics to consuming raw meat by implementing negative status effects and a new disease, increasing the difficulty of food management in survival mode.

### 1. Raw Food Penalties
When a player consumes any uncooked meat (including but not limited to raw beef, raw pork, raw chicken, raw rabbit, etc.), there is a random chance to trigger the following negative effects:
*   **Nausea:** The player will immediately receive a brief Nausea visual effect.
*   **Acute Gastroenteritis:** A new disease status effect introduced by this mod.

### 2. Acute Gastroenteritis Effects
*   **Status Behavior:** While infected, the player's digestive system is compromised.
*   **Penalty Mechanic:** For the duration of this status effect, **every time the player consumes food (regardless of the food type), they will lose a certain amount of health**.

---

## Modpack Compatibility

*   This mod is a lightweight mechanic tweak and is theoretically compatible with all mods that add custom food items (e.g., *Farmer's Delight*).
*   Highly recommended for hardcore survival, realism, or wilderness-themed modpacks.
